name: Caelestia shell, Kibby fork
description: The Caelestia Quickshell shell from Kibby's fork (JagritGumber/caelestia-shell, branch kibby): upstream v2.5.0 with touchpad-lock and mic-mute feedback, each window's own app icon in the bar, tray fixes, lock keys behind keyd, memory and battery alerts, notification icons, the profile picture cropper, a Mixer tab in the dashboard, launcher and recorder changes.
